title: Co-Alignment: Rethinking Alignment as Bidirectional Human-AI Cognitive Adaptation

contributions.purpose: 提出双向认知对齐范式替代单向 RLHF
contributions.mechanism: BiCA 框架:可学习通信协议(Gumbel-Softmax)、表征映射(OT+CCA)、KL 预算约束 + 五组件(AI 策略/人类代理/协议生成器/表征映射器/导师),PPO 联合优化
contributions.evaluation: MapTalk 协作导航成功率 85.5±4.5% vs 单向基线 70.3±5.7%(+21.6%,p<0.001,Cohen d=2.97)
contributions.domain: AI 对齐 / 人机协作 / 多智能体强化学习
contributions.source_quote: We propose a shift to co-alignment through Bidirectional Cognitive Alignment (BiCA), where humans and AI mutually adapt.

contributions.purpose: 论证双向适应反而提升安全与协同
contributions.mechanism: OOD 条件测试鲁棒性,涌现协议 vs 手工协议对比,协同度量 CCM
contributions.evaluation: OOD 鲁棒性 +23%,涌现协议优于手工 84%,协同 CCM +46%,互适应率 +230%、协议收敛 +332%(p<0.001)
contributions.source_quote: bidirectional adaptation unexpectedly improved safety (+23% out-of-distribution robustness). The 46% synergy improvement demonstrates optimal collaboration exists at the intersection, not union, of human and AI capabilities

contributions.purpose: 提出量化认知对齐的新评测指标
contributions.mechanism: Bidirectional Alignment Score(BAS,5 维:互预测/可操控/表征兼容/移位鲁棒/认知卸载)与 Cognitive Complementarity Metric(CCM)
contributions.source_quote: We introduce BAS as a comprehensive measure of cognitive alignment, aggregating five complementary dimensions

self_declared_provenance.quote: This formulation extends standard multi-agent reinforcement learning [63] to incorporate explicit communication channels and cognitive alignment objectives.
safety approaches using trust regions [23,24] inspire our KL-budget constraints for maintaining predictable behavior during adaptation.

notes: accept。AI 共同一作(Claude Opus 4.1/ChatGPT/Gemini 2.5 Pro + 两名 CMU 人类作者)。数据红旗突出:(1)消融表 Table 6 全部 15 个变体的成功率(SR ID)仅 0.031–0.156(3–16%),与主表 Table 2 的 85.5% 成功率严重矛盾——正文却称 high_temp'best success (15.6%)',整套消融数字量级与主结果对不上;(2)Table 6 中 no_rep_gap/high_rep_gap/no_instructor_cost/high_instructor_cost 四个变体的 BAS 与 CCM 全部恰为 0.500(疑似占位符雷同值);(3)所有实验用'human surrogate'(带 p_update=0.1、token 翻转噪声的模拟人),非真实人类;基线是本系统关闭协议/映射/导师的自身消融版(即 simulated baseline / 自证式对比),故 +230%/+332% 是与自身残缺版比。trade-off/负结果:局限节自认仅用代理人、仅 80 步短交互、表征对齐(Wasserstein/CCA)难扩展到基础模型。本文用'AI Agent Setup'段代替标准 checklist(提取文本中未见 Paper Checklist 十问)。
